proprietors.name: [uncertain: J. I. Mulford]
proprietors.basis: The register holds this printed name as person_uncertain_j_i_mulford with action 'new_resident': the town does not carry a card for them under an id this record can name, so the reading is the name and not yet a person. Dated by the printing window, which bounds the reading and does not date the partnership.

locations.basis: The paper names a street and no house on it.
locations.limit_reason: The paper names South Water Street and nothing narrower; the paper gives no anchor.

dates.basis: No opening is announced. The first printing, 1834-07-02, is the bound: the house was trading by then and the record does not say when it began.

proprietor_community.basis: This record names nobody the resident layer holds a card for, so there is no person to read a community off. The silence is in the register.

replaceable_by: A directory, a deed or a later reading that names this house's premises, its staff or its dates more exactly than the newspapers do.
